Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints a handwritten 73,650.88 and is NOT summed as an increment; the same p3 ledger prints its own build-up of that cumulative figure entirely INSIDE THIS ONE DOCUMENT ('All Donations through June 23, 2020: $28,413.88' + 'All Donations through October 27, 2020: $38,237.00' + 'All Donations through December 3, 2020: $7,000.00' = 'Gross Donations (Cash & Loaned) for 2020: $73,650.88'), so no figure was differenced across covers and none was needed. Cover ladder closes independently: line 3 8,057.45 + line 4 7,000.00 = line 5 15,057.45; 15,057.45 - line 6 9,161.34 = line 7 5,896.11.

Printed lines 10-12 carry bare dashes and publish nothing. Column B YTD 67,754.77 is retained as cumulative and never summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only; BOTH conventions tested and IDENTICAL on this filing. The filer's own ledgers carry EXPLICIT in-kind columns ('Amt In-Kind' on Schedule A, 'Expenditures In-Kind' on Schedule B) and every cell in both is a BARE DASH (a nil mark, not a numeral) — and the ledgers' own combined footers prove it: 'Gross Cash, Loaned, & In-Kind Donations: $7,000.00' equals 'Total Cash Donations: $7,000.00', and 'Gross Expenditures: $9,161.34' equals the cash summary. So monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind both close at 7,000.00 / 9,161.34 and no in-kind row exists to publish.
itemized.escalation_note: Eight 900-dpi --value cell crops, all geometry proofs on a ROTATED LANDSCAPE own-ledger where rowbands.py returns ZERO rules (the sheet is a shaded-band spreadsheet with no printed grid, and poppler renders it at -2.0 deg skew). p3: the line-1 box RENDERED '$ 1,000.00', line 2 '$ 5,000.00', line 3 '$ 1,000.00', and the one-past control (line 4) RENDERED '$ -' (a bare dash on an unused ledger line). p4: line 1 RENDERED '$ 5,000.00', line 9 RENDERED '$ 2,500.00', the one-past control (line 10) RENDERED '$ -', and — the finding that mattered — the printed LINE 3 box RENDERED EMPTY, proving the filer skipped one ruled line mid-schedule so that entries 3-8 sit on printed lines 4-9. No figure on this filing was doubtful: every amount is machine type from the filer's own spreadsheet and both sides close to the cent.

itemized.notes: SAKIEVICH DOCUMENT 1 OF 5 IN THIS CHUNK, and the only one of the five that is a legacy_colAB filing. Page-face candidate 'Thomas V. Sakievich', Republican, of Spanish Fork; index.csv's channel label is 'Tom Sakievich' — the page face governs. Office Seeking prints 'Utah County Commission' TWICE (typed in the Office Seeking box and again HANDWRITTEN in the 'Office:' blank beside the report-type checklist) and NAMES NO SEAT; index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat C' — transcribed as printed, no seat inferred. REPORT-TYPE CONFLICT: the checked box on the page face is '30 Days after the General Election' with report date Dec 3, 2020 and a clerk 'RECEIVED DEC 03' stamp, while index.csv's reporting_period reads 'midterm'; the page face governs and both are recorded. Amendment = No. FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover (the 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' county-only blank citing Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5) / p2 SUMMARY PAGE, hand-foliated 'Page 2 of 4' / p3 the filer's OWN typed landscape spreadsheet serving as Schedule A / p4 the same for Schedule B. THE COUNTY FORM'S OWN SCHEDULE A AND B SHEETS ARE ABSENT AND THAT IS NOT A GAP — the entries are all present on the filer's substituted ledgers, so both sides are `transcribed`, never `no-schedule-page` (the ADDENDUM A2 / E5 precedent, here in its ROTATED LANDSCAPE form). The ledgers carry columns the county blank does not: an explicit Amt Loaned column, an explicit in-kind column on each side, and a running cumulative build-up printed inside the document itself. REDACTION: only the cover's signature block is blacked out; donor and vendor street lines are printed IN THE CLEAR throughout and were reduced to city/state at read time on the contribution side and dropped entirely on the expenditure side. Both sides close EXACTLY on the promoted per-period Column A cells (7,000.00 / 9,161.34) and the cover's whole balance ladder closes independently.
